'''Mbinda''' is a [[Bantu language]] of Angola that is closely related to [[Kimbundu]]. Ancestors of the Mpinda included speakers of [[Sama language|Sama]] and [[Kikongo]], and Mpinda has low intelligibility with neighboring languages.
